ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: The capability evals for this kind of straightforward factual explanation are within run-to-run variance between the two models, so quality isn't a deciding factor. The tie-breaker was task-preference fit: Avocet self-reports a preference for open-ended generative work and warm/friendly request tones, and this query is the opposite — a constrained, "just explain it, don't ramble" request with a terse tone. Routing it to Curlew, whose preferences are flat/neutral across dimensions, avoids assigning a low-latitude, cool-toned task to the model that explicitly prefers high-latitude, warm-toned ones. Note: preference slopes are self-reports and don't affect output quality, so this was a soft tie-breaker, not a capability judgment.
